inspiration: Ground lighting recipe: surface colour times a per-vertex colour, plus a baked lightmap added, masked by the lightmap alpha, then multiplied by a directional diffuse term and flat ambient (data/data/shaders/ground.glsl lines 75 to 80). A recipe for baked-plus-dynamic light on our zones.
Prop lighting: one directional light, flat ambient, and an alpha test that discards empty texels (data/data/shaders/model.glsl lines 55 to 59). A cheap lit-prop shader for phones.
Two texture coordinate sets: one for the surface, one for the lightmap (ground.glsl TexCoord0 and TexCoord1). Lets a wear or decal layer use its own UVs.
A zone is one named file picked by a config key with a default name (src/testclient/TestGameMode.cpp line 56). A simple data-first zone switch for our own zone list.
UI icon sheets are one sheet per accent colour, 256 by 240 px by file name (data/data/ui/styles/Delta/images). One icon sheet per faction colour would keep the HUD consistent.
Glass-style panel fill: a semi-transparent gradient strip used as the panel background (data/data/ui/styles/Delta/images, glass strips). A panel fill we can tint per zone.

briefs.label: Baked lightmap plus lit surface
briefs.why: Baked light gives a zone its mood for free, and a small dynamic term keeps moving things lit.
briefs.keep: surface colour times vertex colour; a baked light layer added on top and masked by its alpha; one directional term plus ambient
briefs.change: our own light direction per zone; a time-of-day lightmap swap; a second UV set for decals instead of wear layers

briefs.label: Flat-lit prop with cut-outs
briefs.why: A single directional light and an alpha cut-out keep props readable and cheap at 375 px wide.
briefs.keep: one directional light; flat ambient; alpha test that drops empty texels
briefs.change: a stepped two-tone ramp instead of a smooth diffuse; a rim term on the silhouette; our own ambient colour per zone

briefs.label: Icon sheet per accent colour
briefs.why: One sheet per accent colour keeps every icon of a faction on one texture, which is cheap to draw.
briefs.keep: one 256x240 sheet per accent colour; a 2x variant for the close and slider controls
briefs.change: our own faction sigils instead of generic icons; one sheet per faction colour from our palette; a glyph row sized for thumbs

briefs.label: Named zone file switch
briefs.why: A zone chosen by name from config keeps the level list data-driven, so a new zone needs no code change.
briefs.keep: zone is a named file; a config key picks it; a default zone when the key is missing
briefs.change: our own zone file format; per-zone spawn tables inside the file; a zone-enter cue

briefs.label: Glass HUD panel strip
briefs.why: A see-through gradient strip as panel fill lets the world show behind the HUD.
briefs.keep: semi-transparent gradient fill; a 1x400 strip stretched to panel size
briefs.change: our own tint per zone; an edge highlight for legibility at 375 px; a corner cut instead of a square panel
